feature: POLICE-02 printed police papers (E01 close-up and briefcase no longer blank)
platform: macOS / Apple Silicon, Unity 6000.3.18f1, Metal; muted reviews, isolated review saves

build.method: python3 -X utf8 tools/police/write_police_texts.py -> Unity -executeMethod BuildSlice.RebuildPolice -> OpeningAuthoring.BuildMacIntegrated
build.app: builds/police-papers/错日证词-新版.app (clone of builds/opening/integrated/错日证词-新版.app; not promoted to builds/macos-current)

leftWithoutPaperReason: Prose descriptions of objects (telephones, rain capes, photo board, sealed cage, bed, basin, bound gazette, archive boxes, index cabinet, stove, duty book): printing them as paper would invent text or misrepresent the object.
blankBefore: Only evidence-ID documents use the 3D close-up and the briefcase: E01 (e01-copy, e01-compare) drew a blank sheet; E08 already had Rail/E08.png. The other documents used the plain inspection panel, which showed text only.

street-life 1080p, first run.failure: contacts: car-car 251 - StreetCar0__VisitorMan and StreetCar2__Porter overlapped by up to 7 cm after the signal-corner captures and both stood still; frame p95 33 ms (League of Legends client and Chrome busy on the machine) against 17 ms on the passing build-2 run with the same assembly. No street-life code or asset differs between the builds; the papers change touches none.

earlierCandidate: Build 2 had the same assembly but the first 1024x1320 interview sheet, whose small 日期 label blurred at inspection-panel size; police, police-reload, police-cast, street-life and police 720p all passed on it too (builds/opening/papers-*). Build 3 only swapped that texture (1024x900, larger print) and every review was repeated on it.
buildNoise: Each BuildMacIntegrated rewrote 28 HospitalCast Humanoid/mouth assets and the Hospital, PoliceStation, OpeningRideCar and 11 StreetLife prefabs (float and object-ID noise); all 41 were restored to their exact pre-build bytes (hash-checked).
prefabSemanticChange: Ignoring object IDs, PoliceStation.prefab differs from before only by 11 illustration references and five strings that now follow the pending 物证室→保管室 rename already in PoliceDocuments.json.
